serverConfig: local stdio, profile=full, images=thumbs (the most expensive configuration Inspo offers; the hosted endpoint defaults to lite + images=none)

verdicts.notes: t3 lost on Inspo's own charset slip (mojibake from typographic glyphs without meta charset), fixed the same day by adding a charset line to SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS.

summary.outputTokens: identical across arms (~29k each), so the entire delta is input-side
summary.readMe: cacheRead ran 3.3x cacheWrite in the with-Inspo arm: every tool result is re-read on each subsequent turn, so call count drives cost almost linearly (t2 made 6 calls at $1.60, t4 made 4 at $1.01). Fewer, better-targeted calls beats shrinking any single result.
summary.caveat: Output tokens are estimated from emitted file bytes at ~3.8 chars/token. Per-message usage in the agent transcripts is a message_start snapshot and is unreliable except on messages carrying an `iterations` key; runs are deduped by message.id because multi-block assistant messages log as separate lines sharing one usage object.
